english.name: Free Market
english.description: Build a tank even though your commander has restricted vehicle creation.

schinese.name: 自由市场
schinese.description: 即使指挥官已限制载具生产，仍建造出一辆坦克。

english.name: Just in Time
english.description: Leave your vehicle just before it explodes.

schinese.name: 及时脱身
schinese.description: 在载具爆炸前一刻离开。

english.name: Drive Me Closer
english.description: Get a melee kill while in a vehicle.

schinese.name: 开近点
schinese.description: 在载具内完成一次近战击杀。

english.name: Pacifist
english.description: Have the highest score without any kills.

schinese.name: 和平主义者
schinese.description: 在零击杀的情况下获得全场最高分。

english.name: Back from the Dead
english.description: Kill an enemy just after being revived.

schinese.name: 死而复生
schinese.description: 刚被复活后便击杀一名敌人。

english.name: Quid Pro Quo Pro
english.description: Revive a friendly engineer who recently revived you.

schinese.name: 投桃报李
schinese.description: 复活一名刚刚复活过你的友方工程师。

english.name: Never Give Up, Never Surrender
english.description: Defeat the enemy team before they run out of tickets, despite having no tickets of your own.

schinese.name: 永不放弃，永不投降
schinese.description: 在己方票数已耗尽的情况下，赶在敌方票数耗尽之前击败敌方队伍。
